A run with `display_title=""` then silently fails the `run.get("display_title") == title` filter (line 403), so an internal-review.yml dispatch with an empty title is treated as unbound and skipped — the same fail-open path the round-2 fix was meant to close.
  WHY: Empty-string titles are unlikely but possible (a run pre-dating the workflow `run-name` change, or a malformed API record). The validation docstring claims "every run must also carry a string `display_title`", but an empty string technically satisfies that contract while not actually binding to any PR, so the fail-closed intent does not fully hold for this corner case.
